children: is expected to retrace into a range of $86-$90.72 per barrel in the fourth quarter, before re-testing a resistance zone of $110.71 to $111.92.
The zone is formed by the 100% projection level of a wave c from $78.37 and the 61.8% projection level of a bigger wave C from $70.31.
This wave count is based on an assumption that the rise from $70.31 is an extension of the preceding uptrend from $58.72. At its full capacity, the wave C may travel to $137.64.
However, the resistance zone is so strong that it has triggered a correction, which might be the same degree as the one from the July 3 high of $102.
A channel technique indicates a correction target around $90.72. The current correction may turn out to be very weak, if the market could stabilize around $98.36 and break above $106.31.
Such a break would suggest a continuation of the uptrend toward $123.07, which will be confirmed as a target when the contract breaks $110.71.
On the weekly chart, the uptrend from the December 2025 low of $58.72 could be classified as a continuation of the uptrend from the 2020 low of $15.98.

Alternatively, it could be considered second part of a big downtrend from the March 2022 high of $139.13. Given that the uptrend closely followed a series of projection levels on the uptrend from $58.55, the first scenario is the favoured one.
Under this scenario, the market could eventually climb to $134.54, the 61.8% projection level. The correction triggered by resistance at $105.53 would be temporary.
